about: Serac: the man from the inner systems behind the squeeze, the recall at the jump point and the Institute fire. He offers one favour in a cantina and collects it before the end. In later parts he runs the Mandate's (TAM) operations and the Solar Union's inner-systems 'defence' wing.

serac.meet.title: A drink he isn't drinking
text: A man at the end of the bar has a drink he isn't drinking and a grey coat nobody saw him take off. {serac}. He knows your ship's name, your loan, and what you paid for your last load.
'I arrange things,' he says. 'For friends in the inner systems, mostly. I'd like to arrange something for you. A problem of yours goes away. One day I ask a small favour back.'

choices.say: Take the favour (your next loan payments are settled: +12,000)
Ask who his friends are, then say no
Say no, and leave the drink

serac.friends.title: Everybody, eventually
serac.friends.text: 'Everybody,' {serac.short} says. 'Eventually.' He leaves money for the drink he didn't drink, and the barman will not touch it.

serac.collects.title: A small favour
serac.collects.text: {serac.short}'s small favour arrives in a plain envelope, delivered by a man who waits for the answer. It is not small. He wants something the friends in the inner systems can use, and he wants it this week.

choices.say: Let {convoy_captain.short} put his messenger on the next convoy to the inner systems

variants.text: {serac.short}'s small favour arrives in a plain envelope, delivered by a man who waits for the answer. It is not small: the Hansa's convoy schedules, every route, every month, for a year.
{serac.short}'s small favour arrives in a plain envelope, delivered by a man who waits for the answer. It is not small: your logs from the jump point, the originals, and no copies.

{serac.short}'s small favour arrives in a plain envelope, delivered by a man who waits for the answer. It is not small: every sample of the grey alloy you have, and your silence about where it came from.

serac.petty.title: Lost bookings
serac.petty.text: A dock office loses your berth booking twice in one week, and a customs form you filed in triplicate turns up in none of the three places. The clerk apologises and says a name, quietly.

serac.commission.title: A commission
text: A letter with an inner-systems seal offers you a commission: colonel, in the Solar Union's new Mandate wing for the 'defence' of the inner systems. Good pay, a better ship, no questions asked in either direction.
It is signed {serac}. He has added, by hand: 'You were very good at Alpha. I paid for Alpha, so I would know.'

choices.say: Send it back with the inquiry transcript

after.took_the_commission.title: After: took the commission
after.took_the_commission.text: Colonel of the Mandate's inner-systems wing. The uniform fitted perfectly; it had been made before you said yes.

after.refused_the_commission.title: After: refused the commission
after.refused_the_commission.text: You refused {serac.short}'s commission. The man who took it instead was promoted three times in a year and was never seen in daylight.

after.serac_noticed.title: After: serac noticed
after.serac_noticed.text: {serac.short} kept the transcript you sent back. It was found, decades later, framed in his office: the only thing on the walls.

after.serac.title: After: serac
after.serac.text: Forty years on, the Mandate's inner-systems wing has an office with no name on the door. People who meet the man in it say he has not aged, and that he asks after you.

after.defied_serac.title: After: defied serac
after.defied_serac.text: {serac.short} sent you a card every year after you refused him: no message, no signature, a different dock's postmark each time. You never found out how he knew where you would be.

after.gave_serac_the_logs.title: After: gave serac the logs
after.gave_serac_the_logs.text: Your logs from the jump point were never entered in any record. The legion's history of the convoy is two lines long and mentions nobody.

after.paid_serac.title: After: paid serac
after.paid_serac.text: You paid {serac.short}'s favour and never learned what it bought. Some nights you work it out, and then you stop.

after.sold_the_schedules.title: After: sold the schedules
after.sold_the_schedules.text: The convoy schedules you sold turned up in Cargolyte hands within the year. Nobody traced them to you. You traced them to you.

after.gave_serac_the_samples.title: After: gave serac the samples
after.gave_serac_the_samples.text: The samples you gave {serac.short} were never seen again. Thirty years later a defence contractor in the inner systems patented an alloy nobody could explain.
